_comment: Ability cards. 'params' are level-1 values; 'growth' lists params that scale by +growth_rate per upgrade level. Targets: none | enemy | area | path | defender.

cards.name: Heat Wave
cards.text: Line of fire: {damage} damage, then burns runners.
cards.details: A roaring line of fire from the caster toward the target. Burns runners for {burn_dps}/s. Curved runners take +50% fire damage.
cards.art: A baseball wreathed in roaring flame streaking forward, leaving a wave of fire across infield dirt.

cards.name: Power Throw
cards.text: Hit one runner for {damage} and knock it back.
cards.details: The nearest defender rifles a fastball at one runner for {damage} damage and knocks it back.
cards.art: A white baseball with red stitches rocketing forward with motion streaks and a shockwave ring.

cards.name: Splitter
cards.text: {balls} balls hit runners in the area for {damage} each.
cards.details: A pitch that splits mid-air into {balls} seeking balls, each dealing {damage} to runners in the area.
cards.art: One baseball splitting into five glowing baseballs fanning out in arcs.

cards.name: Grand Slam Barrage
cards.text: {balls} flaming balls rain down: {damage} each + stun.
cards.details: A storm of {balls} blazing baseballs rains on the area, each dealing {damage} and stunning briefly.
cards.art: Dozens of flaming baseballs raining from a dramatic sunset sky onto a stadium like meteors.

cards.name: Grand Relay
cards.text: Team relay throw hits {targets} runners for {damage}+.
cards.details: A relay through the whole team: +20% power per defender, then the ball strikes up to {targets} runners for {damage}+.
cards.art: A golden baseball zig-zagging between glowing relay points, a chain of light gaining power.

cards.name: Power Catch
cards.text: Slam an area: {damage} damage, stun and break armor.
cards.details: Leap and slam: {damage} damage, stuns for {stun}s and shatters armor for {armor_break}s.
cards.art: A giant baseball glove slamming into the ground, cracked earth and purple shockwave.

cards.name: Thunderbolt
cards.text: Lightning: {damage} damage, jumps to {chains} more runners.
cards.details: A lightning fastball for {damage} that arcs to {chains} more runners.
cards.art: An electric yellow baseball crackling with forked lightning bolts.

cards.name: Curveball
cards.text: Slow runners 40% for {duration}s. They take +25% damage.
cards.details: Slows runners by 40% and marks them for {duration}s. Marked runners take +25% damage (+50% from fire).
cards.art: A baseball bending along a sweeping blue curved trail with spin lines.

cards.name: Knuckleball
cards.text: Confuse a runner for {confuse}s so it runs backwards.
cards.details: Confuses a runner for {confuse}s, sending it back the way it came. (Bosses are immune.)
cards.art: A wobbling baseball with question marks and a dizzy spiral trail.

cards.name: Shadow Change
cards.text: Push runners in the area back {pushback}m.
cards.details: A shadowy change-up drags runners back {pushback}m along their route and slows them.
cards.art: A dark purple baseball dissolving into shadow smoke with ghostly hands pulling backward.

cards.name: Time Out
cards.text: Freeze every runner for {freeze}s.
cards.details: The umpire calls time! All runners freeze for {freeze}s (bosses {boss_freeze}s). Defenders keep throwing.
cards.art: A giant stopwatch frozen in ice over a stadium, a referee whistle and a T hand sign.

cards.name: Changeup
cards.text: Slow every runner by 20% for {duration}s.
cards.details: Throws off everyone's timing: all runners are slowed by 20% for {duration}s.
cards.art: A slow-motion baseball with a clock-hand trail and ripples in the air.

cards.name: Pickoff
cards.text: Out a hurt runner (under 35% health). Else {damage} damage.
cards.details: Instantly outs a non-boss runner below 35% health. Otherwise deals {damage} damage.
cards.art: A teal-gloved hand slapping a tag on a sliding runner's boot at a base, motion lines.

cards.name: Lockdown
cards.text: Lock runners in place for {root}s.
cards.details: Roots runners for {root}s, then slows them. Lasts {home_bonus}s longer near home plate.
cards.art: Blue energy chains and a padlock wrapped around home plate, a catcher's mitt behind.

cards.name: Frost Field
cards.text: Ice the area for {duration}s: runners 50% slower.
cards.details: Freezes the turf for {duration}s: runners slow by 50% and throws gain +30% crit chance against them.
cards.art: Infield turf freezing over with jagged ice crystals and a frosted baseball.

cards.name: Wall of Dirt
cards.text: Block a path with a wall for {duration}s.
cards.details: Raises an earthen wall across a basepath that blocks runners for {duration}s or until it takes {hp} hits of damage.
cards.art: A wall of packed infield dirt erupting from the ground across a white chalk baseline.

cards.name: Base Shield
cards.text: Home plate blocks the next run.
cards.details: Shields home plate. The next runner to reach home is thrown out instead of scoring. (Max 3 shields.)
cards.art: A glowing hexagonal energy dome over home plate.

cards.name: Bunt Trap
cards.text: Trap a path: stops the next {charges} runners.
cards.details: Lays a sticky trap on a basepath that roots the next {charges} runners for {root}s and deals {damage} damage.
cards.art: A sticky glowing net trap laid on a basepath with a bunted ball resting in it.

cards.name: Diving Catch
cards.text: Dive in: {damage} damage, knock back and stun.
cards.details: A full-extension dive: {damage} damage, knocks runners back {knockback}m and stuns them.
cards.art: A pink-trimmed glove at full stretch snagging a ball in mid-air above the grass.

cards.name: Twin Play
cards.text: For {duration}s every throw bounces to a 2nd runner.
cards.details: For {duration}s every throw ricochets to a second runner for 70% damage. Chains also add +1 bounce to relays and lightning.
cards.art: Two baseballs orbiting each other with green motion trails, a double-play arrow.

cards.name: Field Vision
cards.text: Defenders +25% range for {duration}s. Reveals tricksters.
cards.details: Defenders gain +25% range for {duration}s, and Tricksters and decoys are revealed (cannot dodge).
cards.art: A glowing eye with a baseball iris over a tactical map of the diamond.

cards.name: Diamond Aura
cards.text: Aura on a defender: nearby allies +40% damage.
cards.details: A defender radiates a diamond aura for {duration}s: allies within {radius}m deal +40% damage and throw 25% faster.
cards.art: A radiant blue-white diamond gem with beams of light over a baseball diamond.

cards.name: Rally Cry
cards.text: All defenders throw 30% faster for {duration}s.
cards.details: The dugout roars! All defenders shake off stuns and throw 30% faster for {duration}s.
cards.art: A megaphone blasting a golden shockwave with a cheering crowd silhouette.

cards.name: Magnet Glove
cards.text: Pull runners in the area together and hold them.
cards.details: Drags runners in the area to its center and holds them for {pull_time}s. Combos with area cards.
cards.art: A baseball glove crackling with magnetic field lines pulling baseballs in.

cards.name: Sky Hook
cards.text: Hit the runner nearest home for {damage}, pull it back.
cards.details: A sky-high hook throw hits the runner closest to home for {damage} and yanks it back {pull}m.
cards.art: A baseball arcing high into a twilight sky trailing cyan light, curving down like a hook.

cards.name: Seventh-Inning Stretch
cards.text: Gain {energy} energy and draw {draw} cards.
cards.details: Take a breather: gain {energy} energy and draw {draw} cards.
cards.art: A stadium crowd stretching with arms raised under evening lights, popcorn and pennants.
